values.note: All 10 RV sites have water and 50 A; 3 of them also have sewer. The 10 tent sites have water and 20 A.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/keowee-toxaway/camping ('7 sites have 50 amp service and water'; '3 sites have 50 amp service, water and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 paved RV sites up to 40 ft total vehicle length; 'Larger units will have difficulty navigating the campground road.' Plus 10 tent sites with water and 20 A power, and 3 hike/paddle-in backcountry sites.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/keowee-toxaway/camping ('Ten paved sites ... can accommodate RVs up to 40 feet total vehicle length'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/keowee-toxaway/camping ('restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-868-2605). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/keowee-toxaway/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/keowee-toxaway/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC agency row

note: Near the banks of Lake Keowee; winding park roads are harder for larger rigs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50 A + water; added sewer (3 full-hookup sites), 10 RV sites up to 40 ft, showers, dump, SC's 13-month window, 2-night minimum and 14-night max. Fees left as read 2026-10-11. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: season, pull-throughs.
